pending_leads.summary: Paired-case opportunity for AAEXP-0003. A Carnegie Mellon communications piece headlined 'Ownership Language in Text Reminders Yields Action' covers the same study whose own claim is scoped and solid. Pairing the institutional communication layer against the paper's own wording would give a source-voice contrast case in the style of case_public_001.
pending_leads.why_valuable: Source-voice contrast; the library records no source voice for 47 of 48 active cases, so voice-contrast pairs are a structural gap.
pending_leads.next_step: Verify the press-release exact wording and publication date from the CMU domain directly. Requires its own candidate ID and full verification pass.
risks: Must not be attributed to the paper authors (§11)
Press headline may be judged fair simplification rather than overclaim

resolved_decisions.decision: Real-world-sourced candidates. Existing synthetic fixtures may remain canonical but are NOT the template for the 150.
operating_rules: Do NOT rewrite dossiers into canonical evaluation-task YAML.
Record per-dossier conversion suitability: canonical_case | blind_packet | both | neither.
Treat house-format conversion as a separate curator/packet-authoring step.
Estimate curator conversion workload in every batch report.

resolved_decisions.decision: archive_url, source_sha256, and persistent_identifier are best-effort fields, not universal hard gates.
curator_ready_still_requires: source sufficiently recoverable for later curator review
prohibitions: Do not invent identifiers or hashes.
Do not reject a strong case solely because an external archive service is unavailable.
resolved_decisions.still_reject_or_hold_when: the original claim itself is unstable, unverifiable, or unlikely to remain recoverable

resolved_decisions.decision: Skew the expansion toward the currently thin labels. Documented §7 exception.

section_7_exception.deviates_from: §7 acceptable final range: at least 30 and no more than 45 cases per primary label among the 150 new candidates
section_7_exception.specific_breach: overclaim portfolio target of 27 falls below the §7 floor of 30
section_7_exception.justification: Active canonical library is 47.9% overclaim (23 of 48) while correlation_vs_causation and mechanism_vs_evidence sit at 6 each. Taxonomy v0.6.5 independently records correlation_vs_causation as 'mature but thin' and mechanism_vs_evidence as 'Developing' with the weakest model accuracy (53% avg). Skewing new intake corrects a real merged-library imbalance.

qc_001_resolution.decision: Keep the frozen biological definition of mechanism_vs_evidence and reduce its expansion target. Do not extend, reinterpret, or broaden the frozen taxonomy during this operation.
qc_001_resolution.classification_rule: Non-biological cases (technical mechanisms, simulations, laboratory-only software performance, benchmark behaviour, cybersecurity defenses) must NOT automatically receive mechanism_vs_evidence. Classify under the label matching the actual dominant defect — normally overclaim, correlation_vs_causation, or solid.
qc_001_resolution.metadata_field_required: future_taxonomy_review: { possible_domain_general_mechanism_analogue, notes } — research metadata only, not a fifth label, no taxonomy force.
qc_001_resolution.deferred_issue: future_taxonomy_review_issue.md — do not resolve during this expansion run.
